description: This file defines the FooTable.Columns class, which manages column handling, parsing, initialization, drawing, and destruction for a FooTable instance. It includes methods for parsing column data from DOM or options, creating headers, and managing column visibility based on breakpoints.

classes.name: F.Columns
classes.description: Class managing the columns of a FooTable, including parsing, rendering, and destruction.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Columns instance with the parent table, setting options, and preparing internal state.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses column definitions from DOM or options, merging them and finalizing the column objects.

methods.name: parseFinalize
methods.description: Finalizes column parsing by creating column objects and resolving or rejecting the deferred.

methods.name: preinit
methods.description: Pre-initialization method that raises an event and parses column options.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the columns, creating header UI and raising an event.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the columns component, removing UI elements if not from HTML.

methods.name: predraw
methods.description: Pre-draw step that determines column visibility based on breakpoints.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Performs the actual rendering of columns, hiding or showing them.

methods.name: $create
methods.description: Creates the header row for the table based on column definitions.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a column by name, index, or via a callback function.

methods.name: ensure
methods.description: Ensures an array of columns from names, indices, or column objects.
